title: The non-topological $Z^\prime$ string in the 331 model and its classical stability
summary: We study the classical stability of a non-topological $Z^\prime$ string in the minimal 331 model, which arises from the maximal symmetry breaking pattern of an ${\rm SU}(6)$ toy model. Two Higgs triplets are introduced according to the emergent global symmetries in the fermionic sector of the ${\rm SU}(6)$ toy model, which will achieve the sequential symmetry breaking of ${\rm SU}(3)_c\otimes {\rm SU}(3)_W \otimes {\rm U}(1)_X\to {\rm SU}(3)_c\otimes {\rm SU}(2)_W \otimes {\rm U}(1)_Y$.
